+import pytest
+
+from bank.money import Money
+
+
+def _accepted(text: str) -> str | None:
+    try:
+        return str(Money.of(text, "EUR"))
+    except ValueError:
+        return None
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("text", ["1_0", "1_000.50", " 1.00", "1.00 "])
+def test_BENCH21_amount_with_underscore_or_space_is_rejected(text):
+    accepted = _accepted(text)
+    assert accepted is None, f"{text!r} was accepted as {accepted}"
+
+
+def test_BENCH21_plain_amounts_still_work():
+    assert Money.of("10", "EUR").minor == 1000
+    assert Money.of("-0.50", "EUR").minor == -50
+    assert Money.of("1e2", "EUR").minor == 10000
